hat_control_timing: metal/tone/decay/shape/drive/freq/velocity latch on onset; choke strength latches on choke edge
instrument_polyphony: one note per DSP; allocation, overlap, stealing and cross-voice choke routing belong to consumer
sequencer_outputs: step: trailing telemetry, 0 before first tick, then 1..32
sequencer_reset: positive edge arms first step; simultaneous running clock emits first step
sequencer_stop: hold position, no output; clocks while stopped still update edge detector
sequencer_length_edit: apply modulo on next clock edge, retain previous step telemetry until then
source_rights: Owner-authored laboratory source; no new third-party source imported. Inherited Faust library notices apply. Distribution licence selection remains separate.
